title: UwU
blurb: Weaponised softness, deployed sincerely on rare occasions and as an act of aggression almost always. Nothing destabilises a Discord call faster than a grown adult pressing this button into thirty seconds of silence. The room does not recover. The effect lands somewhere between endearing and genuinely threatening, and it keeps its power by never resolving either way. The uwu register has been a fixture of internet speech for years and has survived several attempts to kill it off. Use it for wholesome moments, for cursed moments, and for the substantial overlap between the two where most of the internet actually lives.
